mapper.select: select * from fnd_base_rate_set order by valid_from

SELECT tab.* from (SELECT fbrs.*, fc.currency_name FROM fnd_base_rate_set fbrs, fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = fbrs.currency )tab
1=1
and tab.base_rate_set like concat(concat('%',#{baseRateSet}),'%')
and tab.description like concat(concat('%',#{description}),'%')
and tab.base_rate_type =#{baseRateType}
and tab.currency_name =#{currencyName}
order by tab.valid_from desc

SELECT fbr.description||':'||fbr.base_rate*100||'%' description, fbr.*
FROM fnd_base_rate_set fbrs, fnd_base_rate fbr WHERE fbrs.base_rate_set = fbr.base_rate_set
and fbr.months_from < #{loanTerm} and fbr.months_to >=#{loanTerm}
and fbrs.base_rate_type =#{baseRateType} and ((fbrs.valid_from <= sysdate and fbrs.valid_to >= sysdate ) or (fbrs.valid_from <= sysdate and fbrs.valid_to is NULL)) and fbrs.enabled_flag = 'Y'
